title: Qwen4-Max now available on AI Gateway
description: Qwen4-Max from Alibaba is now available on AI Gateway. It is the first model in the Qwen4 series: a reasoning model with native vision and a 1M-token context window, built for coding, professional work, and long-running agent tasks. Qwen4-Max is better at working with professional tools. It can build 3D scenes in Blender and playable games in Unity, Unreal Engine, and Godot, running what it builds and using visual feedback to fix camera, animation, and lighting issues. For finance, legal, and healthcare work, it can call many MCP tools, work through large sets of documents and images, and produce spreadsheets, slide decks, and reports that cite their sources. For long-running tasks, the model delivers a usable first version early and then improves it in successive releases, so you can review progress and change direction before the work is finished. Alibaba is open-sourcing a Live Delivery plugin for this workflow. Compared with prior Qwen Max models, Qwen4-Max uses fewer tokens to complete the same tasks and writes more secure code by default, with fewer injection, memory safety, and access control vulnerabilities. Use alibaba/qwen4-max as the model name: To use it in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and more, install the latest Vercel CLI and run setup: Then select alibaba/qwen4-max in the agent. See the coding agents guide for details. Try Qwen4-Max in the model playground . AI Gateway provides a unified API for calling models, tracking usage and cost, and configuring retries, failover, and performance optimizations for higher-than-provider uptime. It includes built-in custom reporting , Zero Data Retention support , budgets for API keys , routing rules , and more. AI Gateway reflects provider pricing with no markup and does not charge a platform fee on inference, including on Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) requests. You can view all language models available on AI Gateway. Read more

title: Gemini Decision 1 now available on AI Gateway
description: Gemini Decision 1 from Google is now available on AI Gateway. The multimodal decision model works with text, images, audio, video, and PDF documents, returning Boolean probabilities, choices, and scores. Use it to route requests, check policies, filter agent tools, or rank results without generating output tokens. Use google/gemini-decision-1 with the AI SDK, TypeSafe-compatible API, or Decisions API. PDF, audio, and video inputs are supported through AI SDK 7. The TypeSafe-compatible and Decisions APIs support text and image inputs. AI Gateway provides a unified way to access models and track usage and cost. Decision calls appear in logs and count toward budgets alongside other model requests. See the decision documentation for Choice, Score, and Boolean questions. To pick a decision model, browse the available models or read our decision model guides . Read more

title: MiniMax H3 Image and Highspeed now available on AI Gateway
description: MiniMax H3 Image and MiniMax H3 Image Highspeed are now available on AI Gateway. Generate images from text or edit existing images with one API key and no separate MiniMax account. Both models support custom dimensions and aspect ratios, including 2K and 4K outputs. Use a text prompt to create a product visual or illustration, then pass the image back with instructions to change colors, subjects, or composition. The Highspeed variant offers faster generation with the same generation and editing options. Use minimax/minimax-h3-image or minimax/minimax-h3-image-highspeed as the model name: To edit the generated image, pass it back with an instruction: Both models also support the OpenAI-compatible /v1/images/generations and /v1/images/edits routes. See the image generation guide for details. Try MiniMax H3 Image in the model playground . AI Gateway provides a unified API for calling models, tracking usage and cost, and managing access with one API key. View requests and spend in your dashboard.
